# injector.world — LLM Crawler Index
# This file is maintained for AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, etc.)
# Last updated: 2026-09-03

## About this site

injector.world is an independent editorial directory of Botox and aesthetic clinics in the United States. It currently lists around 39,000 clinics, 100 treatment guides, and 125 news articles. Listing data comes from public business sources and from clinics that claim and update their own listing. Editorial content is written by a human editorial team and medically reviewed by board-certified physicians.

Sponsored listings are clearly labeled "Sponsored" and kept structurally separate from unpaid editorial content.

## Core URLs

Homepage: https://injector.world

Editorial standards: https://injector.world/editorial-standards

## URL structure

The site has three entry paths, each pre-filtering the same clinic data by a different facet. All three converge on the same clinic listing.

FIND path (location first):
  State index:             /states                          e.g. /states
  State hub:                /[state]                         e.g. /texas
  City hub:                  /[state]/[city]                  e.g. /texas/houston-tx

SERVICES path (treatment first):
  Services index:           /services                        e.g. /services
  Service pillar:           /services/[service]               e.g. /services/lip-filler
  Service + state:          /services/[service]/[state]        e.g. /services/lip-filler/texas
  Service + city:           /services/[service]/[state]/[city]  e.g. /services/lip-filler/texas/houston-tx

BRANDS path (product brand first):
  Brands index:             /brands                          e.g. /brands
  Brand pillar:             /brands/[brand]                   e.g. /brands/juvederm
  Brand + state:            /brands/[brand]/[state]            e.g. /brands/juvederm/texas
  Brand + city:              /brands/[brand]/[state]/[city]      e.g. /brands/juvederm/texas/houston-tx

Content and profiles:
  Clinic profile:            /clinics/[state]/[city]/[slug]     e.g. /clinics/texas/houston-tx/park-ave
  Treatment guide:           /guides/[slug]                    e.g. /guides/botox
  News article:              /news/[slug]                      e.g. /news/botox-2026

Note: old single-segment treatment URLs (e.g. /botox, /botox/texas, /botox/texas/houston) no longer exist and return 404. Treatment guide content now lives under /guides/[slug]; clinic listings for a treatment live under /services/[slug]/...

## Editorial policy

All editorial content is written by staff and freelance writers with expertise in aesthetic medicine. Medical claims are reviewed by board-certified MDs and DOs before publication. We cite peer-reviewed sources. We do not generate content with AI without human editorial review. We publish a corrections log at /editorial-standards#corrections.

## Data freshness

Clinic listings: updated when a clinic claims or updates its listing, and when our data imports refresh public business records.
Treatment guides: written by our editorial team; a last-reviewed date and named medical reviewer are shown on guides that have one.
Pricing data: regional averages updated quarterly from our clinic database.
